Nowadays many people thinks that studying online is more effective then studying in traditional classroom. In my opinion, both ways has their own advantages and disadvantages, and the choice depend on the personality of student. First of all, online learning give students more freedom. They can watch lectures in any time, repeat difficult parts and study from home without spending hours in the traffic. For example, my cousin was working and studying at the same time, and without online courses she would never finished her degree. On the other hand, traditional classes provides discipline and live communication. When student sit in the classroom, it is more harder to get distracted by phone or social media. Moreover, teachers can see immediately if somebody don't understand the topic and explain it again. To sum up, I believe that the best solution is combine both formats, because it allow students to take the flexibility of online learning and the structure of offline one.

Abstract. We investigate the thermal stability of perovskite solar cells under prolonged illumination and elevated humidity. Devices were fabricated using a mixed-cation lead halide composition and encapsulated with a thin polymer barrier layer deposited by spin coating. Over a period of 1,200 hours, we monitored power conversion efficiency, open-circuit voltage and fill factor at three temperature levels: 25, 55 and 85 degrees Celsius. Our results show that encapsulated devices retained 91 percent of their initial efficiency at 55 degrees, while unencapsulated reference cells degraded to 38 percent within the first 300 hours. At 85 degrees, however, both groups exhibited rapid decomposition of the perovskite layer, accompanied by the formation of lead iodide crystals visible in X-ray diffraction patterns. We attribute this behavior to ion migration at grain boundaries, which is accelerated by heat and cannot be fully suppressed by encapsulation alone. These findings suggest that compositional engineering, rather than packaging, should be the primary focus for achieving long-term operational stability in real outdoor conditions.

Всем привет, с вами снова я, и сегодня мы будем готовить хачапури по-аджарски у меня на кухне.
Честно, я долго боялась браться за тесто, потому что у меня оно вечно то липнет, то не поднимается.
Но в этот раз я нашла рецепт, который работает даже у таких криворуких, как я.
Нам понадобится мука, тёплое молоко, сухие дрожжи, немного сахара, соль и сливочное масло.
Для начинки берём сулугуни и имеретинский сыр, если имеретинского нет, можно заменить на адыгейский.
Тесто замешиваем минут десять, пока оно не перестанет прилипать к рукам, и оставляем в тепле на час.
Пока оно подходит, натираем сыр и смешиваем его с одним яйцом и ложкой сметаны.
Теперь формируем лодочки, края подворачиваем плотно, иначе сыр убежит в духовке.
Печём при двухстах двадцати градусах минут пятнадцать, потом в центр разбиваем желток и возвращаем ещё на две минуты.
Сверху кусочек масла, и всё, можно есть, только осторожно, внутри просто лава.
